At home tonight — the Square: Odette, Constance; the Market: Jory, Dorian, Agnes; the Docks: Hollis, Isolde, Lian; Chapel Hill: Greta, Edda.
The Demon does not kill on the night before you arrive. It kills from night 1.
Choose your night work: 'ward <name>' (shield them from the demon, once per case), 'vigil <block>' (watch who goes out from a block at night), or 'sleep'.

Jory: "Oh! Almost forgot: From my window, I saw Greta out in the street last night."  [case board: #58]

Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Lamplighter."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 2 others out."
Isolde: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 3 others out."  [case board: #60, #61, #62]

=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Isolde: "For everyone's sake, I should tell you: Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 5 others out."  [case board: #91]
Agnes: "Oh, From my window, I saw Isolde out in the street on the first night."  [case board: #92]
Isolde: "Please forgive me for speaking on fear alone, yet something about Agnes frightens me."  [case board: #93]
Constance: "For your consideration: Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Isolde pass by."
Constance: "I have grave doubts concerning Isolde. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #94, #95]
Lian: "Edda belongs at the top of our list. Dorian's records tie them to the Revenant."  [case board: #96]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Dowser."
Greta: "On day 1, in the morning, on the Market I sensed 1 evil among Hollis, Agnes, Isolde."
Greta: "On day 2, in the morning, on the Market I sensed 1 evil among Odette, Edda, Isolde."
Greta: "This morning, on the Market I sensed 1 evil among Hollis and Isolde."  [case board: #97, #98, #99, #100]
Hollis: "I concur with Constance's assessment of Isolde."  [case board: #101]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Veteran."
Odette: "If anyone is keeping score, I don't trust Constance. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."
Odette: "From my window, I saw Isolde out in the street on the first night."  [case board: #102, #103, #36, #104]
